description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten digit "7" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive-like style, with a slightly slanted and flowing appearance. The top of the "7" is curved and extends to the right, while the vertical line descends from the upper right portion of the curve, forming a sharp angle at the bottom. The stroke is relatively thin and consistent in thickness, suggesting it was drawn with a fine-tipped writing
